A bus collided with a truck on Kenya’s main highway on Sunday, killing at least 22 people, police said.

The crash came three weeks after 17 people died in another accident along the same highway linking the capital, Nairobi, with the coastal city of Mombasa.

Several others were injured in the Sunday morning crash and were receiving treatment, police said.

The passengers were reportedly returning from a funeral when the accident occurred.

Makueni County Commissioner Abdullahi Khalif said that the death toll could rise.

The circumstances surrounding the crash remain unclear. Speeding and poor road conditions have previously been cited as contributing factors in road accidents in Kenya.

Kenya’s National Transport and Safety Authority said the stretch of the highway where the crash occurred is a designated “accident black spot” and that recommendations had been made to address safety concerns.

Sean McVay has spent the better part of a decade building a reputation as one of football’s brightest minds. Six weeks into the 2026 NFL Season, and the Los Angeles Rams’ head coach is getting outsmarted by the one person who should know his offense better than anyone.

The Rams are currently 2-4, dead last in the NFC West, and watching their Super Bowl dreams unravel one self-inflicted wound at a time.

And while McVay deserves enormous credit for transforming this franchise into a perennial contender, he deserves an equally large share of the blame for its current predicament.

Let’s start with special teams, an annual problem McVay has allowed to fester like an untreated infection.

For years, the Rams have tried to get by with bargain-bin kickers, questionable personnel decisions and a reluctance to expose starters on special teams. The revolving door at kicker has become almost comical, except nobody in Los Angeles is laughing anymore.

Harrison Mevis missed four field goals before being released, including a blocked 48-yard attempt in overtime against Buffalo that helped seal another heartbreaking defeat.

But why was Mevis attempting a 48-yarder in the first place?

With Matthew Stafford carving up Buffalo’s defense, McVay inexplicably called a run on third-and-5 that gained nothing, settling for a long field goal instead of trusting his reigning MVP to move the chains.

Afterward, McVay admitted he regretted the decision.

“I wish I would have had a better play call and gone forward, got it a lot tighter. I’m sick right now with myself,” he said.

Then there’s the lack of discipline on display by his team week in and week out.

The Rams entered this season accustomed to being among the NFL’s least-penalized teams. Instead, false starts, holding calls and other mental mistakes have repeatedly sabotaged promising drives.

“I can’t deny that because we had some critical moments in critical situations,” said McVay when asked if his team is undisciplined this season compared to last. “We had a couple key and critical ones where you jump offsides on fourth-and-three…then you jump offsides on the first play of their two-minute drive when you’re trying to sustain the lead and win the game. We have to do a better job and it starts with me.”

“It starts with me,” has become a weekly catchphrase for McVay during this tumultuous season and his accountability has been admirable. Unfortunately, we can’t say the same about his play-calling a lot of the time.

Against Arizona, McVay called a fourth-and-1 handoff to tight end Davis Allen, who had never carried the football in an NFL game. Later, facing fourth-and-8, he dialed up another predictable screen pass that was blown up.

The result? Another embarrassing loss, 18-16, to a Cardinals team that entered as a 12.5-point underdog.

McVay’s offense has become maddeningly predictable until desperation strikes.

Give Stafford the football with two minutes remaining and suddenly the Rams look unstoppable. For the other 55 minutes, they’re frequently stuck in neutral, squandering opportunities to build comfortable leads and allowing opponents to hang around.

It’s why four consecutive games have come down to the final play, with Los Angeles losing three.

McVay keeps turning games that should be decided by execution over four quarters into coin flips. Lately, the coin keeps landing on the wrong side.

Even the season-opening debacle in Australia falls at his feet. McVay chose to arrive in Melbourne barely a day before kickoff, while San Francisco arrived nearly a week earlier. The Rams looked sluggish in a 27-7 loss.

“Sometimes you win, sometimes you learn and sometimes you have a dumbass coach that makes travel plans that put you in a bad spot,” McVay later admitted.

To be fair, McVay cannot control the avalanche of injuries that has devastated his roster. Poona Ford, Kobie Turner, Davante Adams, Puka Nacua, Myles Garrett and several other key contributors have been sidelined. Nor can he control Alaric Jackson throwing a postgame punch and getting suspended, or questionable officiating decisions against Josh Wallace that cost them victories in Denver and last week against Arizona.

But injuries don’t explain everything, and bad calls don’t excuse bad coaching.

McVay himself acknowledged the uncomfortable truth after Sunday’s loss.

“We won’t win a game unless we figure out how not to beat ourselves,” he said.

He’s right. And as McVay likes to say, that starts with the man on the headset holding the play sheet.

To be clear, nobody is suggesting McVay should be fired. That would be ridiculous. He’s the youngest head coach in NFL history ever to win a Super Bowl. He’s still one of the NFL’s premier coaches, and the Rams would struggle to find anyone better. If McVay was fired tomorrow, 30 other NFL teams would quickly fire their current head coach to hire him.

But greatness doesn’t grant immunity from criticism.

The good news? The same coach responsible for many of these problems is uniquely qualified to solve them.

With 11 games remaining, McVay still has time to rediscover the creativity, discipline and killer instinct that made the Rams champions in 2021 and got them one play from winning the Super Bowl again in 2025.

That turnaround must begin Sunday against the Las Vegas Raiders. McVay has an opportunity to finally shine when everyone around him is doubting him. For six weeks, he failed to live up to the postseason hype and expectations that come with being the preseason Super Bowl favorites.

Now those expectations have vanished like the players in his starting lineup and McVay has the chance to exceed them. Something he’s excelled at throughout his career.

On Sunday, the Rams don’t need another postgame press conference that begins with “it starts with me.” They need the wunderkind coach who made everyone else in the league look a step behind.

For most people, October signals the arrival of fall weather, apple cider, and Halloween parties.

But for a section of the gay community and a growing number of straight people, the month goes by another name: Locktober, and its meaning is most definitely R-rated.

Locktober is an annual month-long celebration around chastity, observed by many in the BDSM and kink communities. Participants wear a chastity cage around their penis that prohibits them from having sex, often under the stewardship of a dominant partner who holds the key.

The annual chastity kink is one of the fastest-growing fetishes, according to Clips4Sale, which named it its 2025 Fetish of the Year after chastity content sales surged 71%.Dan Berman, founder and CEO of KINK3D, a company that makes the cages and charges upwards of $220 for one, claimed that it’s not actually about repression or constraint.

“For people who are in the world of BDSM (bondage and discipline) or kink, chastity actually has the opposite effect,” he explained to The Post. “It really ramps up and intensifies sexuality.”

Basically, it does mean locking up the penis and metaphorically throwing away the key (there is a hole to urinate), and it is possible to still get an erection, sort of.

“You get, what I would say is, a partial erection,” Berman said. “It will redirect it downward; it will restrict how hard you can get. You will still get aroused, but there is definitely a feeling of compression and not being able to get a full erection.”

Even though it’s called Locktober, practices vary on how long you wear the cage, and Berman advises newcomers to corral their chastity yearnings.

“Some people like to go into it with the dream that they will put the cage on at midnight on Oct 1 and not take it off for the next 31 days. There are some people who do that, but we think it’s probably not the best plan for most people. Realistically, taking some breaks for hygiene is important,” he counseled.

“A lot of people have trouble sleeping at night in their cage, and we have done a lot of work making cages a lot more comfortable. Even with that, it’s still challenging for a lot of people. Nighttime erections are involuntary; they can wake you up.”

He advises people to view them as contact lenses or glasses —  something you take off before you go to sleep and you put back on the minute you wake up.

Berman estimates his clientele is split evenly between gay and straight customers, and says the item also serves as a fashion accessory at sex parties and fetish clubs.

In the gay hookup world, it can serve as a deterrent for men who pressure others to be ‘tops.’

“So, for people who really want to emphasize that they’re bottoms, they really like wearing the cage to sort of take their penis off the table, symbolically and practically,” Berman expounded.

He shared that straight couples use it often to spice up their sex life.

“It inverts the discourse over what is typically masculine,” Berman said. “It lets couples do that in a way that is playful and fun and a little bit kinky.”

It can also put more emphasis on a woman’s pleasure and orgasm.

“We hear about that all the time,” he revealed. “Sometimes it can reinvigorate the spark in relationships by taking the men’s orgasm off the table for a little bit and making the woman the center of pleasure.”

Tom, who asked The Post to refrain from using his real name, has been in a relationship with a woman for the last 2 years, and agrees with that assessment.

“My girlfriend has said to me that she has never had so much confidence,” he explained. “Having that power over me boosts her confidence and makes her feel stronger.”

Tom laughed when asked if his girlfriend has been having more orgasms this October than any other month before acknowledging that it was true.

“It’s really interesting how it changes something in my brain,” the 37-year-old explained. “All I do is focus on her pleasure while we engage in sexual activity during Locktober.”

And when it comes off, Tom said everything is heightened.

He even pointed out that being aroused during the abstemious annual — it’s his second time around — is pleasurable.

“If anything, I kind of lean into it,” Tom shared, “and enjoy the arousal. What I’ve learned is going into an entire month without orgasms is [that] it kind of turns into extended foreplay. In a way, everything becomes sexualized.”

Sebastian, who also refrained from giving his real name, a gay man in his 30s who has done Locktober for the last six years, sees the experience as more spiritual than sexual.

“It’s more of a challenge, a test of willpower, learning to deny what would be a base urge,” he told The Post. “The first couple of days are very hard, but by the end you have an achievement.”

That’s not to say that Sebastian doesn’t have any sexual encounters during the month, but he’s upfront about the cage.

Sebastian confessed that wearing the cage “makes things a little bit different, but there are ways around that with strap-ons and other accessories…but for the month you’re thinking, ‘Hey, do I stay out late and try to find someone to hook up with or do I go home and get enough sleep and hit the gym early?’ So, it’s like a wellness check, too.”

He added that everyone “has a different experience and reason why” they’re strapping on the cages.

“It has grown into more than just a curiosity in both communities,” he noted.

The Raiders should send the Rams a thank-you card.

Nothing extravagant. Certainly nothing that suggests they intend to be gracious hosts Sunday at Allegiant Stadium.

Just a little acknowledgment that sometimes the people who stand in the way of what you want inadvertently help you find exactly what you need.

In the Raiders’ case, that turned out to be Las Vegas. And a magnificent stadium that looks like someone took the franchise’s personality, poured it into an architectural drawing and built it just off the Strip.

Their home. Their identity. Their town, at least when it comes to the NFL.

Getting here required swallowing a bitter pill. But with the Rams arriving Sunday for their first game at Allegiant Stadium, preseason or regular season, the Raiders can appreciate how that disappointment helped change their future.

They might have gotten something better.

To understand how, rewind to 2015, when three NFL franchises were searching for stadium solutions and Los Angeles was the biggest prize on the board.

The Rams had an escape hatch in St. Louis. The Edward Jones Dome had failed to satisfy the first-tier stadium requirements in their lease, allowing them to shift to a year-to-year arrangement and pursue a return to Southern California.

Rams owner Stan Kroenke, a land developer at heart, had his eye on 298 acres in Inglewood, on which he would build a state-of-the-art stadium and surround it with a massive mixed-use master-planned district.

The Raiders were stuck trying to make an increasingly untenable stadium situation work in Oakland. The Chargers were fighting their own seemingly endless battle to secure a new home in San Diego.

Eventually, the Raiders and Chargers joined forces on a proposed shared stadium in Carson.

Two AFC West rivals, united by necessity.

What followed was a yearlong soap opera of competing proposals, shifting alliances and powerful owners trying to determine who would get access to the country’s second-largest market.

Kroenke had the money and the development vision to deliver something far beyond a football stadium in Inglewood. His project offered the NFL a destination, a showcase and a solution to a Los Angeles problem that had dragged on for two decades.

But solving Kroenke’s problem also meant figuring out what to do with the Raiders and Chargers.

By clicking above you agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

A two-team stadium offered a way forward.

And from a football perspective, the obvious pairing was sitting right there.

Two proud franchises with deep Los Angeles roots, established followings and enough cultural differences to create a fascinating civic rivalry.

Think USC and UCLA, with fewer recruiting arguments and considerably more silver and black.

The same Raiders popularity that made the pairing compelling, though, also made it complicated for the Rams. Building a spectacular stadium is one thing. Sharing it with a franchise capable of commanding so much of the hometown attention is another.

Ultimately, the NFL approved the Rams’ move and gave the Chargers the first option to join them. The Raiders were left waiting, with an opportunity contingent on the Chargers passing.

Your stadium situation remained unresolved. Your preferred relocation plan had fallen apart. And your next move depended, in part, on someone else’s decision.

Then Las Vegas emerged as a real possibility.

What followed took considerable work, political support and a substantial public investment. Nevada and the Raiders assembled the partnership Oakland could not, creating a stadium agreement that transformed the franchise’s financial future while giving Las Vegas a major new stage.

The Raiders got their long-sought home. Las Vegas got an NFL team and a building capable of attracting events far beyond the football schedule.

The difference for the Raiders went beyond a new address.

For years, their stadium predicament had defined so much of their existence. Every conversation about their future seemed to come with a question mark.

Las Vegas replaced that uncertainty with permanence.

And an identity that requires no explanation.

Look at Allegiant Stadium. The dark exterior. The silver-and-black sensibility. The unmistakable connection between the building and the franchise playing inside it.

There is no need to negotiate whose personality the place should reflect.

Life in Los Angeles could have been good. The Raiders would have reconnected with a passionate fan base and played in a spectacular stadium.

But they would have shared that NFL home, its identity and its place in the market with the Rams.

In Las Vegas, they have something entirely their own.

None of that wins Sunday’s game. Financial success does not block a pass rusher, fix the running game or close out a fourth-quarter lead. The Raiders still have plenty to prove where it matters most to their fans.

But the Rams’ visit offers a reason to appreciate the strange route that brought them here.

The Raiders can spend Sunday trying to send their guests home unhappy.

Before kickoff, though, a small, begrudging thank-you would be appropriate.

Thanks for leaving us out.

How often in the Kyle Shanahan era could we say the 49ers weren’t built to win a shootout?

At least for one week, the tables are turned.

Mike Evans will not suit up which means Brock Purdy will be missing all of his top six receivers.

A hobbled Evans will have extra time to rest with the bye week on the horizon.

At 6-0, the 49ers have the margin for error to play it safe this week.

But if they want to take their perfect record into their bye — then they’re going to have to find another way to win.

That starts and ends with Raheem Morris’ game plan against his former employer.

But even if Morris’ unit pitches a shutout, Shanahan will have to find a way to do something he wasn’t able to last week as San Francisco escaped with a 23-17 win over the Commanders:

Move the ball and put points on the board without Evans.

The two games that Evans has left early with injuries have simultaneously been the 49ers’ closest calls to spoiling their unbeaten beginning to the season. They went up 23-6 shortly after Evans left with broken ribs in Week 3 only to barely hang on to beat the Cardinals 36-30. Last week, they nearly allowed a 23-3 advantage to evaporate once Evans left the game.

If plus-minus was a football stat, Evans would be right near the top of the league leaders.

The biggest news, opinion and culture shaping California right now.

By clicking above you agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

A full game without their undisputed top receiver could be too much to overcome.

That is, unless the 49ers’ remaining crew of castaways and never-beens has something to say about it. If anybody has the ability to scheme open an overmatched receiver, it’s Shanahan.

“Maybe he’s not calling all the ones he’d call for Mike Evans, but we’re still calling plays,”  said tight end George Kittle, who will probably act as Purdy’s top option. “I think we’re on our fifth or sixth wide receiver. I don’t really find that as an excuse. I think our wide receivers are more than capable of running the plays that Coach Shanahan has called for us.”

It will be a challenge to run the ball against Jeff Ulbrich’s defense, which has limited its first six opponents to a paltry 3.6 yards per carry, sixth-best in the NFL. But the 49ers’ personnel situation will make it difficult to take advantage of a porous pass defense that has allowed the fifth-most air yards in the NFL (252 per game).

Evans played only 25 snaps before leaving the game last week, but he still hauled in as many passes (three) for more yards (94) than the 49ers’ next three receivers — Brandin Cooks, Jordan Watkins and Jacob Cowing — who combined to play 94 snaps.

It’s no wonder why the 49ers couldn’t move the sticks in the second half against Washington. Evans has been on the receiving end of 25 of the 49ers’ 68 first-down conversions through the air, almost twice as many as their next pass-catcher, Kittle, with 13.

Purdy has been the league’s best quarterback so far this season, despite losing receivers by the week. He’s proven he can operate even with Kittle at less than full strength, and the 49ers have made it this far without leaning too hard on Christian McCaffrey.

The one weapon they haven’t been able to play without is Evans.

He might just be the most important of them all.

The Bears showcased one method for eliminating the Falcons’ best weapon last week. They jumped out to an early lead and Robinson went on to touch the ball only 11 times. With the shape the 49ers’ offense is in, that might be a tall task. It will fall on their defensive line’s shoulders to contain arguably the NFL’s most efficient and explosive runner. Robinson is averaging 5.8 yards per carry, second in the NFL, and has 15 runs of 10 or more yards, fourth-most in the league. His average 2.9 yards before contact is fourth among NFL running backs. The 49ers, on the other hand, have yielded the fewest big gains on the ground (four runs of 10-plus yards) while limiting opponents to 3.9 yards per attempt (7th). “He’s as tough as it gets,” said defensive coordinator Raheem Morris, who also happened to be Robinson’s head coach the past two seasons. “You’ve got to keep him behind line of scrimmage. You’ve got to swarm tackle this guy. You’ve got to get him on the ground.”

49ers’ record under Kyle Shanahan in 10 a.m. PT starts. This is their first of only two East Coast trips this season. The Falcons are 0-3 inside Mercedes-Benz Stadium.

Los Angeles’ top federal prosecutor fears noncitizens could be illegally casting ballots in California as dozens of polling places opened across LA County Saturday, warning the state could be trying to run out the clock before disputed votes are counted.

First Assistant US Attorney Bill Essayli told The California Post it’s “very highly likely” noncitizens have already voted, as the Justice Department fights to have California set aside ballots tied to more than 20,000 suspected noncitizens.

“If you look at California’s own papers, they said they’ve already processed over 300,000 ballots just for LA County. So this is going on as we speak,” Essayli said, warning that more disputed ballots could be cast as the lawsuit plays out in court.

Essayli and US Attorney General Todd Blanche are leading the Justice Department’s push for the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals to force California to set aside the disputed ballots and verify voters’ citizenship before counting them.

The battle centers on a list of more than 20,000 people that California Secretary of State Shirley Weber and Los Angeles County Registrar-Recorder Dean Logan did not review within the department’s requested timeframe.

As the federal and state officials battle in court, with oral arguments set for Sunday, Essayli worried that California’s continued efforts to fight the DOJ’s order will lead to untold illegal votes being tallied.

“Our biggest fear is they’re just going to try to run out the clock until all the ballots have been processed, in which case there will be nothing we’ll be able to do after the election,” Essayli said, citing recent state election results with razor-thin margins. “Once they count the ballots, there’s no way to go back and undo that.”

On Saturday, early in-person voting for the Nov. 3 election began at 123 vote centers across LA County, with hundreds of additional locations scheduled to open next weekend.

“When you vote in person, it’s even more concerning because that ballot is processed instantly,” Essayli noted of potential noncitizen ballots being cast.

Only days earlier, federal agents arrested 28 alleged illegal voters in a sprawling operation that netted targets across California, drawn from the list of 20,000 suspected noncitizens.

They were charged with fraudulently registering to vote in US elections, in which most of them allegedly cast illegal ballots. Authorities called it the biggest such takedown in the state’s history.

“All of them were registered to vote and some of them voted in multiple elections. So this is not a theory,” Essayli said.

The prosecutor wondered why any state leaders would fight the Justice Department’s efforts, saying opponents have dismissed claims of any illegal voters as representing only a “small percentage” of scofflaws.

“So what percentage is acceptable? I’d like to know from California,” Essayli said.

Before launching its lawsuit, the Justice Department supplied LA County with a password-protected thumb drive identifying the suspected noncitizens who were sent mail-in ballots, according to letters sent last week to Weber and Dean Logan.

Logan said at the time that he didn’t consider the drive a secure device and hadn’t accessed any files.

“What are they afraid of? Why are they refusing to work with us to figure this out?” Essayli said. “If they’re so confident that their records are so good and noncitizens aren’t voting, then they should have nothing to worry about.”

Sports betting writer Dylan Svoboda is in his third season in the Post’s NFL Bettor’s Guide.

Things are starting to unravel in Indianapolis, and a trip to Minnesota to face the undefeated Vikings is hardly the ideal opportunity to turn things around.

The Colts couldn’t even beat the previously winless Titans at home Sunday, blowing a 13-point halftime lead in an embarrassing 26-20 defeat that caused the franchise to make some drastic moves.

The loss proved to be the final straw for general manager Chris Ballard, who was fired Monday after Indianapolis dropped to 2-4.

The Colts’ offense has also been trending in the wrong direction, with injuries taking a toll on their receiving corps and Daniel Jones coming off a miserable performance in which he was sacked six times and committed three turnovers.

The Vikings, meanwhile, are coming off a bye week and should be well-rested for this matchup.

Quarterback Kyler Murray looked particularly sharp in his last outing after a slow-ish start to his career in Minnesota, completing 24 of 30 passes for 229 yards and a touchdown while adding 51 yards on the ground in a 23-13 win over the Saints.

Colts pass protection ace Sauce Gardner is also expected to miss time with a calf strain, which is good news for Murray and Justin Jefferson, who has dealt with an ankle sprain over the past few weeks and surely enjoyed his week off.

And the Vikings’ defense has been among the NFL’s best, making life miserable for opposing quarterbacks.

With Minnesota rested and beginning to find its rhythm offensively, this looks like a particularly difficult spot for a Colts team that appears to be heading in the opposite direction.

Look for the Vikings to stay undefeated with ease Sunday.

Dylan Svoboda is a versatile writer and analyst across many sports. He’s particularly knowledgeable about the big three — MLB, the NFL and the NBA.

news.originalContent:
بی‌بی‌سی دریافته است که مگان مارکل، همسر شاهزاده هری پسر دوم پادشاه بریتانیا، پارسال ارتباط با پدرش را قطع کرد و به او گفت که خودش و مقامات می‌دانند که او دختران خردسال را آزار داده است.

منابع نزدیک به مگان مارکل می‌گویند که او در نامه‌ای به پدرش، توماس مارکل، هشدار داد که دیگر نوه‌هایش را نخواهد دید.

گفته می‌شود که این نامه زمانی برای توماس مارکل، ۸۲ ساله، ارسال شد که پس از جراحی قطع پا در بیمارستانی در فیلیپین بستری بود.

براساس گزارش‌ها، تصاویری از سوءاستفاده جنسی از کودکان، که گفته می‌شود متعلق به توماس مارکل است، در خانه سابق او در فیلیپین پیدا شده است.

پلیس بریتانیا هم در سال ۲۰۱۹ مگان مارکل را در جریان اتهام‌های وارده به پدرش قرار داده بود. توماس مارکل که اکنون در ایالات متحده ساکن است، تمامی این اتهام‌ها را رد می‌کند.

مگان مارکل از سال ۲۰۱۸ با پدرش قطع رابطه کرده است. در آن سال، پدرش برای مشکل سلامتی در مراسم عروسی سلطنتی دخترش شرکت نکرد.

به نظر می‌رسد نامه‌ای که مگان مارکل در سال ۲۰۲۵ برای پدرش فرستاد، نقطه پایانی بر رابطه پرچالش این پدر و دختر بوده است.

این نامه نخست در گزارش امروز یکشنبه روزنامه بریتانیایی سان منتشر شد. بنابر این گزارش مگان مارکل به پدرش نوشته است که دگر نوه‌هایش، آرچی و لیلی‌بت، را نخواهد دید و خودش هم هیچ‌وقت با او تماس نخواهد گرفت.

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

توماس مارکل جونیور، برادر ناتنی مگان، روز جمعه به روزنامه سان گفت که مجموعه‌ای از عکس و ویدئو پدرش را در خانه سابق او در فیلیپین پیدا کرده است.

گفته می‌شود او در ماه ژوئیه به اف‌بی‌آی اطلاع داد که در میان آنها ویدیوها و تصاویری مربوط به سوءاستفاده از کودکان یافته است.

اف‌بی‌آی تایید کرده است که از این اتهامات آگاه است.

مارکل جونیور ۶۰ ساله، در مصاحبه‌اش با روزنامه سان از مگان عذرخواهی کرد چرا که در دوران طولانی قطع رابطه ابتدا جانب پدرش را گرفته بود.

او گفت: «اکنون می‌دانم که در ۹ سال گذشته، از فرد اشتباه حمایت می‌کرده‌ام.»

مقامات فیلیپین تایید کرده‌اند که در حال بررسی اتهام‌های پدر مگان مارکل هستند. آنها روز جمعه به بی‌بی‌سی گفتند که کارگروه مبارزه با قاچاق انسان و بهره‌کشی جنسی از کودکان مشغول رسیدگی به این موضوع است.

جان‌ویک رمولا، وزیر کشور فیلیپین، نیز اعلام کرد که پلیس کامپیوتر توماس مارکل را ضبط کرده است و قرار است بررسی‌های دقیق ویژه جرایم جنایی انجام دهد.

در همین حال، توماس مارکل در مصاحبه‌ای با روزنامه میل آن ساندی اذعان کرد که در سفرهای پیشین خود به فیلیپین در ازای رابطه جنسی پول پرداخت کرده است اما رابطه جنسی با دختران زیر سن قانونی و داشتن تصاویر مربوط به سوءاستفاده جنسی از کودکان را تکذیب کرد.

این تحولات در حالی رخ می‌دهد که پلیس متروپولیتن لندن روز شنبه (۲۴ اکتبر) تایید کرد که در سال ۲۰۱۹ نامه‌ای حاوی «چندین ادعا» در مورد پدر مگان دریافت کرده بود.

پلیس متروپولیتن گفت که در آن زمان، نامه مذکور را در اختیار دوک و دوشس ساسکس (هری و مگان) قرار داد اما محتوای آن را به سایر نهادهای مجری قانون منتقل نکرد.

پلیس متروپولیتن گفت که اکنون در حال بازبینی نحوه رسیدگی این نهاد به این پرونده است.

مگان روز جمعه (۲۳ اکتبر) در بیانیه‌ای از نامه پلیس متروپولیتن در سال ۲۰۱۹ خبر داد و گفت که آن نامه حاوی «اتهامات دلهره‌آور» درباره پدرش بوده است.

مگان نوشت: «من عمیقا آزرده هستم. فکرم با کودکانی است که ممکن است آسیب دیده باشند.»

او ابراز امیدواری کرد که اکنون دیگران درک کنند که چرا با پدرش قطع رابطه کرد و «به او اجازه ندادم با فرزندانم تماس داشته باشد.»

مگان تنها دختر توماس مارکل و مادرش، دوریا رگلند، است.

توماس مارکل سال گذشته، پس از آنکه چندین بار دچار سکته مغزی شد، به فیلیپین نقل مکان کرد.

گفته می‌شود او اکنون در یک مرکز توانبخشی در فلوریدا به سر می‌برد و پس از قطع یکی از پاهایش، در حال تلاش برای دوباره راه رفتن است.

او ابراز امیدواری کرد که اکنون دیگران درک کنند که چرا با پدرش قطع رابطه کرد و «به او اجازه ندادم با فرزندانم تماس داشته باشد.»

مگان تنها دختر توماس مارکل و مادرش، دوریا رگلند، است.

توماس مارکل سال گذشته، پس از آنکه چندین بار دچار سکته مغزی شد، به فیلیپین نقل مکان کرد.

گفته می‌شود او اکنون در یک مرکز توانبخشی در فلوریدا به سر می‌برد و پس از قطع یکی از پاهایش، در حال تلاش برای دوباره راه رفتن است.

news.originalContent:
US media reporting that Pentagon has drawn up plans to renew strikes after November 3 midterm elections, but analysts question what another bombing campaign could achieve.

The US military has drawn up options for renewed attacks on Iran, according to the Washington-based website The Hill, raising the prospect of another round of major fighting in a war approaching its eighth month.

Central Command (CENTCOM), which oversees US forces in the Middle East, has plans ready for follow-up strikes if authorised by the White House, the outlet reported. It also said military planners had prepared several options for Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

The report focused on possible attacks after the November 3 US midterm elections. But President Donald Trump suggested on Saturday that the United States could strike as soon as “tomorrow”, while also holding out the possibility of a “big, beautiful” agreement with Tehran.

Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, meanwhile, accused Washington of derailing negotiations but said efforts to reach an agreement should continue. With both sides warning of further attacks, could the conflict tip back into full-scale war? Here is what we know.

The latest reporting suggests military preparations are advancing, although it remains unclear which options Trump might approve or when. Earlier this month, Axios reported that the Pentagon had instructed CENTCOM to complete preparations for a possible resumption of major combat operations. Its sources said a renewed campaign could target Iranian energy facilities, infrastructure and nuclear sites.

Those preparations do not amount to an order to attack. The decision ultimately rests with Trump, whose public statements continue to leave room for both military action and negotiations.

Meanwhile, on Wednesday, The New York Times reported that the US and Israel have drawn up joint plans for an attack on Iran after the midterm elections. The reports come alongside US warnings about alleged Iranian threats to American personnel overseas. An intelligence memo sent on Friday by Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton to Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Iran had “substantially increased efforts to target US personnel”, with lethal plots reaching “advanced stages” in the Middle East and elsewhere.

The Department of State has ordered staffing reductions at several regional embassies amid the warnings. The publicly reported memo did not identify specific targets or establish when any alleged attacks might occur.

Trump has added to the uncertainty. At a rally on Friday, he said Washington “may do another little Epic Fury”, referring to the codename of the US-Israeli military operation against Iran that began on February 28. On Saturday, he declined to disclose the timing of any possible attack while suggesting one could come as early as Sunday.

Julie Norman, associate fellow at Chatham House, told Al Jazeera the preparations served both as short-term posturing and a possible longer-term military objective next month. “With Trump, I think he is always keeping options on the table, but I think this particular drawing up of plans is an immediate posturing deterrent, but also a very real option after the midterms,” she said.

It comes as the US is deploying a third aircraft carrier strike group, the USS Theodore Roosevelt, along with roughly 10,000 additional soldiers and the 13th Marine Expeditionary Unit to the Middle East by the end of November.

Tehran has combined calls for further negotiations with warnings that renewed US attacks would bring a wider response. “We were having negotiations, the cowards [Americans] messed everything up,” Pezeshkian said in remarks broadcast on Saturday, before adding that efforts to conclude the agreement should continue.

Iran’s parliament speaker and chief negotiator Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf will also miss the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum in New Delhi, according to the Iranian Embassy in India. The embassy cited “unforeseen circumstances” without elaborating.

On Sunday, Iran’s army also said it had shot down a US-developed LUCAS drone over the southern port city of Bandar Abbas, according to the semi-official Tasnim news agency.

The Reuters news agency has reported, quoting Iranian security officials, that Tehran has drawn up plans to target undersea communications cables in the Gulf in the event of a resumption of US and Israeli attacks.

The incident followed Iranian claims that seven oil tankers had caught fire or sustained damage in and around the Strait of Hormuz earlier this week, while on Wednesday, Iran also announced what it describes as a shift towards an “offensive” military doctrine, warning that countries hosting bases used in US attacks could become targets.

“Our defence doctrine was previously defensive; we used to say that if a country attacks us, we will respond. Now we say that if a country attacks us, we will both respond and launch an offensive,” Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps spokesman Hossein Mohebi said.

The warning raises the prospect of a confrontation spreading further across the region, with energy infrastructure and countries aligned with Washington potentially exposed. “Iran is also drawing up its own target lists to include energy infrastructure and US-aligned states,” Norman said.

“So I would say both parties are certainly very prepared for another round of escalation and projecting preparedness to each other.”

“In the meantime, there is a very high risk of miscalculation by either side, a very high risk of rapid escalation.”

October has become the worst month for attacks on ships since the war began in February, with more than 120 attacks reported so far.

The timing is politically sensitive, with Trump facing pressure to avoid renewed escalation before the US midterm elections, while Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has been pushing for an attack as his support dwindles in the polls ahead of Tuesday’s election.

It comes after Netanyahu said overthrowing Iran’s government remains Israel’s “primary objective”.

Mohamad Elmasry, a professor at the Doha Institute for Graduate Studies in Qatar, said recent developments pointed towards renewed fighting rather than a diplomatic breakthrough. “There is a lot of signalling, a lot of posturing suggesting that we are headed for another round of fighting,” he told Al Jazeera.

He pointed to Hegseth’s recent visit to Israel, and Washington’s reported withdrawal of personnel from regional diplomatic and military sites. “All of that would suggest that the US and Israel are planning [another round of attacks] on Iran, either soon or very soon,” he said.

“One of the fears is this next round of fighting could actually be more dangerous, more catastrophic than the previous round.”

Norman added that while the US president may be eyeing up a strike on Iran after the midterms, “the big question for Trump from military advisers is – what would a further round of escalation bring that the other rounds didn’t?”

“What would these strategies do to force Iran to the negotiating table? And I don’t think there has been a clear answer to that.”
news.content: رسانه‌های آمریکایی گزارش می‌دهند که پنتاگون برنامه‌هایی برای از سرگیری حملات پس از انتخابات میان‌دوره‌ای 3 نوامبر طراحی کرده است، اما تحلیل‌گران این سوال را مطرح می‌کنند که کمپین بمباران دیگری می‌تواند چه دستاوردی داشته باشد. به گفته وب‌سایت The Hill مستقر در واشنگتن، ارتش ایالات متحده گزینه‌هایی را برای حملات مجدد به ایران طراحی کرده است که دورنمای دور دیگری از درگیری‌های بزرگ را در جنگی که به ماه هشتم خود نزدیک می‌شود، افزایش می‌دهد. این نشریه گزارش داد که فرماندهی مرکزی (سنتکام) که بر نیروهای آمریکایی در خاورمیانه نظارت می‌کند، برنامه‌هایی آماده برای حملات بعدی در صورت مجوز کاخ سفید دارد. همچنین گفت که برنامه ریزان نظامی چندین گزینه را برای وزیر دفاع پیت هگزث آماده کرده اند. این گزارش بر حملات احتمالی پس از انتخابات میان دوره ای ایالات متحده در 3 نوامبر متمرکز شده است. اما دونالد ترامپ، رئیس جمهور آمریکا روز شنبه پیشنهاد کرد که ایالات متحده می تواند به زودی «فردا» حمله کند، در حالی که احتمال یک توافق «بزرگ و زیبا» با تهران را نیز محفوظ می دارد. مسعود پزشکیان، رئیس جمهور ایران، در همین حال، واشنگتن را به از بین بردن مذاکرات متهم کرد اما گفت تلاش ها برای دستیابی به توافق باید ادامه یابد. با هشدار هر دو طرف در مورد حملات بیشتر، آیا ممکن است درگیری به جنگی تمام عیار بازگردد؟ این چیزی است که ما می دانیم. آخرین گزارش ها نشان می دهد که آمادگی های نظامی در حال پیشرفت است، اگرچه هنوز مشخص نیست که ترامپ چه گزینه هایی را ممکن است تایید کند یا چه زمانی. اوایل این ماه، Axios گزارش داد که پنتاگون به CENTCOM دستور داده است تا مقدمات از سرگیری احتمالی عملیات‌های رزمی بزرگ را تکمیل کند. منابع آن گفتند الف

news.originalContent:
The IRGC says it wants to use main squares in every capital of Iran’s 31 provinces for the Janfada campaign.

Iran’s authorities are increasing investment in a campaign to arm and train civilians who would serve in the state security apparatus against domestic and foreign threats amid growing fears that fighting with the United States and Israel could resume imminently.

The public mobilisation drive – called Janfada, or “those who sacrifice their life” – was launched in late March at the peak of the war with the US and Israel. It has now spread to large parts of the country and is aiming to attract volunteer men and women. It has a stated focus on youth but is open to all ages.

At their numerous street booths and stations, representatives of the Basij militia of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) and other state bodies offer training on using weapons and other equipment to defend the government and its “revolutionary” values.

State-organised events and armed “exercises” linked with the mobilisation campaign have been held in Tehran, Isfahan, Zanjan, Shiraz, Kerman, Mashhad, Bojnord, Ahvaz and other big and small cities across many of Iran’s 31 provinces.

Ali Kowsari, Basij’s deputy for training, announced during a news conference this month that the IRGC wants to use at least 14 main squares across Tehran as training and equipment stations for Janfada volunteers. The goal is to use at least one to three squares in the capital city of every single province, he said, without divulging how many cities are currently being used as part of the campaign.

State-run nighttime events are sometimes held with rallies and motorcades during the day. A resident of Gilan province in northern Iran told Al Jazeera that people regularly see state-run stations on the streets in big and smaller cities across the province during their commutes.

“Sometimes they hold competitions to win some small prizes. They bring in live bullets, teach people how to load them into magazines, how to arm pistols and assault rifles, and how to aim and fire,” the resident said, asking to remain anonymous for security reasons.

“The organisers are mostly old men. Since the start of the war, they’ve gathered around the main square almost every night, also often playing revolutionary tunes and chanting from loudspeakers.”

In Gilan’s city of Rasht on October 15, residents objected to the noise and blocking of the street for the nighttime pro-government gathering. Videos circulating on social media showed a confrontation that escalated into a brawl although the authorities did not comment.

On Saturday, authorities cautioned residents in Alborz province’s Karaj near Tehran that they could expect explosions and loud noises from one of the Janfada exercises.

Last week, there was a big mobilisation campaign in northwestern Iran’s Kurdistan province, which borders Iraq.

The IRGC-linked Tasnim News Agency characterised a procession in the provincial capital, Sanandaj, as an exercise in “unity” between the Shia and Sunni Muslim populations.

But a number of foreign-based Iranian human rights groups have characterised such armed mobilisation efforts as “intimidation” campaigns that are held months after January’s nationwide protests, during which thousands of civilians, including many young people, were killed from gunshots and stab wounds.

The government has acknowledged that protests took place in more than 400 counties across all provinces but describes them as a “coup” attempt wholly orchestrated by the US and Israel to overthrow the establishment. It also rejected findings by an independent United Nations fact-finding mission that said the authorities committed crimes against humanity while cracking down on the protests.

Mehran Kamrava, a professor of government at Georgetown University in Qatar, said the US-Israeli war on Iran has “presented another opening for the more revolutionary elements of the Iranian body politic”.

“Revolutions are like riding a bicycle. To avoid a nasty fall, you must pedal hard. And this is precisely what the Janfadas and their leaders are trying to do – to remain relevant,” he told Al Jazeera.

“The Janfada’s training mobilisation also gives the more revolutionary-minded figures within the Iranian leadership a chance for choreographed displays of political and ideological loyalty to the revolution and its principles,” the professor said.

The government said 33 million Iranians have signed up on the campaign’s website but has provided no evidence to support this number.

It represents more than a third of the country’s population, or more than half of the over-12 population, men and women.

Earlier this year, foreign-based activists accessed the website’s source code, which showed that fewer than four million people had registered. Only a phone number was required for registration, and no national identification number was needed.

Speaking last week about the political goals of the campaign, Nematollah Bagheri, IRGC commander for the province of Lorestan, said: “The aim is to show that, just as the government supports the people, the people support the Islamic Republic and the Islamic revolution.”

Organisers said registrants could be used in future rescue operations and for social services and media and financial support. The government has also asked them to help ease the pressure of the US war, naval blockade and sanctions by consuming less fuel, electricity and other resources.

The establishment’s efforts to expand the campaign have only grown after nearly eight months of attritional war, which has killed thousands of people, made Iranians poorer and seen parts of the country’s civilian infrastructure destroyed.

Children have become a major focus for the campaign, and schools have increasingly been accommodating mobilisation. Last week, Education Minister Alireza Kazemi said the Basij militia was registering “student Janfadas” and had plans for more mobilisation and ceremonies involving children over the coming weeks.

Kamrava, the university professor, said this kind of mobilisation does not necessarily broaden the scope of the state’s legitimacy among the larger society.

“It does, however, serve to deepen the legitimacy that the state already has among its existing supporters. It reinforces belief in the revolution’s ideological and political mission and reifies the siege mentality that all revolutionaries have,” he said.
news.content: سپاه پاسداران می‌گوید که می‌خواهد از میدان‌های اصلی در هر مرکز از ۳۱ استان ایران برای کمپین جانفدا استفاده کند. مقامات ایران در حال افزایش سرمایه‌گذاری در کمپینی برای تسلیح و آموزش غیرنظامیانی هستند که در دستگاه امنیت دولتی در برابر تهدیدات داخلی و خارجی خدمت کنند، در میان نگرانی‌های فزاینده مبنی بر از سرگیری جنگ با ایالات متحده و اسرائیل. حرکت بسیج عمومی - به نام جانفدا یا "کسانی که جان خود را فدا می کنند" - در اواخر مارس در اوج جنگ با ایالات متحده و اسرائیل راه اندازی شد. اکنون در بخش‌های وسیعی از کشور گسترش یافته است و هدف آن جذب مردان و زنان داوطلب است. تمرکز آن بر جوانان است اما برای همه سنین باز است. در غرفه‌ها و ایستگاه‌های متعدد خیابانی، نمایندگان بسیج سپاه پاسداران انقلاب اسلامی (سپاه پاسداران انقلاب اسلامی) و سایر نهادهای دولتی آموزش استفاده از سلاح و سایر تجهیزات برای دفاع از دولت و ارزش‌های «انقلابی» آن را ارائه می‌دهند. رویدادهای سازماندهی شده دولتی و «مانورهای» مسلحانه مرتبط با کمپین بسیج در تهران، اصفهان، زنجان، شیراز، کرمان، مشهد، بجنورد، اهواز و سایر شهرهای بزرگ و کوچک در بسیاری از ۳۱ استان ایران برگزار شده است. ایستگاه برای داوطلبان جانفدا. او گفت، هدف استفاده از حداقل یک تا سه میدان در مرکز هر استان است

news.originalContent:
Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted drone and missile launched towards Riyadh and 10 missiles targeting the southern region.

Saudi Arabia has intercepted drones and missiles over its capital, Riyadh, and southern areas, the Saudi-led coalition has said, as fighting with Yemen’s Houthis continues.

Coalition spokesman Major-General Turki al-Maliki said on Sunday its forces intercepted and destroyed a Houthi ballistic missile launched towards the capital city that morning, as well as a drone in the Riyadh region, and a cruise missile aimed at the southwestern city of Khamis Mushait, with explosions ringing out in the Saudi capital.

It later reported the interception of 10 ballistic missiles fired towards southern ‌Saudi Arabia.

The attacks come as operations resumed at two terminals at Saudi Arabia’s King Khalid international airport after deadly attacks earlier this month by the Houthis, an armed group also known as Ansar Allah (Arabic for Supporters of God).

Operations at the airport were halted on October 10 after 13 people were killed and more than 300 others were wounded in a Houthi attack.

Late on Saturday, Riyadh airport said in a statement that international flights would resume from Terminal 2 on Sunday, while Terminal 1 would be designated for domestic flights.

Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree warned that the airport was still “unsafe” and a “military target” for the Iran-backed group.

“The Yemeni Armed Forces warn all international, regional and local airlines – as well as staff and travellers – against using King Khalid airport in Riyadh, as it is unsafe and serves as a military target for our forces,” he said. “The Saudi regime shall bear the consequences of any operations at the airport.”

The Iran-aligned Houthis on Saturday said they targeted three Saudi airports, including one in Riyadh, energy installations, a pipeline and an airbase.

The Saudi civil defence agency said it also responded to falling debris in the Mecca and Medina regions on Saturday after intercepting two Houthi missiles.

The Houthis denied targeting Mecca and Medina, two of the holiest cities in Islam, calling the Saudi claim a “huge lie”.

In Yemen on Sunday, the Houthis advanced on Jabal Sabr, the strategic mountain overlooking the city of Taiz, which has become the focus of the fighting between the Houthis and Yemen’s government forces.

Houthi fighters have besieged the city and cut off the main road to Aden, which serves as the interim capital of Yemen’s internationally recognised government.

The United Nations has warned that “time is running out” to deliver aid to the 800,000 people trapped in the city.

Yemen’s government forces, meanwhile, said they conducted more than 700 operations against Houthi targets on Saturday, claiming to have killed more than 300 fighters.

Fighting between government forces and Houthi fighters has intensified across multiple fronts in Yemen in recent weeks, causing a spiralling humanitarian crisis.

The war in Yemen escalated sharply when the Houthis seized strategic territory from forces loyal to the country’s internationally recognised government along the Red Sea coast last month.

The Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, which is aligned with Yemen’s government forces, have dealt a huge blow to the kingdom, the world’s biggest exporter of crude oil, disrupting its businesses, airlines and normal life, and damaging its international image.
news.content: ائتلاف به رهبری عربستان می‌گوید پهپاد و موشک شلیک شده به سمت ریاض و 10 موشک را که منطقه جنوبی را هدف قرار می‌دهند، رهگیری کرده است. ائتلاف به رهبری عربستان سعودی اعلام کرد، در حالی که درگیری با حوثی‌های یمن ادامه دارد، عربستان هواپیماهای بدون سرنشین و موشک‌ها را بر فراز پایتخت خود، ریاض، و مناطق جنوبی رهگیری کرده است. سرلشکر ترکی المالکی سخنگوی ائتلاف روز یکشنبه گفت که نیروهای این ائتلاف یک موشک بالستیک حوثی را که صبح همان روز به سمت پایتخت شلیک شده بود، و همچنین یک پهپاد در منطقه ریاض و یک موشک کروز را که به سمت شهر خمیس مشیط در جنوب غربی هدف گرفته بود، رهگیری و منهدم کردند. جنوب عربستان سعودی این حملات در حالی انجام می شود که پس از حملات مرگبار در اوایل ماه جاری توسط حوثی ها، گروهی مسلح که به انصارالله (عربی برای حامیان خدا) نیز شناخته می شود، عملیات در دو ترمینال در فرودگاه بین المللی ملک خالد عربستان سعودی از سر گرفته شد. عملیات در فرودگاه در 10 اکتبر پس از کشته شدن 13 نفر و زخمی شدن بیش از 300 نفر دیگر در یک حمله حوثی متوقف شد. اواخر روز شنبه، فرودگاه ریاض در بیانیه ای اعلام کرد که پروازهای بین المللی از ترمینال 2 روز یکشنبه از سر گرفته می شود، در حالی که ترمینال 1 برای پروازهای داخلی تعیین می شود. یحیی سریع، سخنگوی ارتش حوثی ها هشدار داد که فرودگاه همچنان "ناامن" و "هدف نظامی" برای گروه مورد حمایت ایران است.

news.originalContent:
Ali Usman has also been recalled to the Test team after being sent home from the England tour.

Former skipper Salman Agha has returned to Pakistan’s Test cricket squad for the upcoming series against Sri Lanka, but there was still no place for Mohammad Rizwan following the team’s disastrous tour of England.

Agha and Rizwan were among seven players expelled from the Test tour of England in August, a series the visitors lost 3-0.

In Pakistan’s first squad since, five players remain out of favour, including wicketkeeper-batsman Rizwan, who is the subject of an ongoing investigation by the country’s cybercrime agency.

Earlier this week, the Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) allowed Rizwan to feature in a domestic match.

Agha was left out of this month’s T20 series against Sri Lanka, but the 32-year-old impressed in the ongoing One-Day International (ODI) series at home, scoring a century against Sri Lanka last Sunday.

Along with Agha, left-arm spinner Ali Usman was also recalled after being sent home from the England tour before the third and final Test.

Babar Azam will continue to lead the side in the two Tests against Sri Lanka in Rawalpindi (November 9-13) and Lahore (November 17-21).

The 14-member squad includes a trio of uncapped batters – Mohammad Taha, Sameer Minhas and Mohammad Suleman – who have done well at domestic level.

The two-match series is part of the World Test Championship, with Pakistan ninth and last and Sri Lanka seventh.

Squad: Babar Azam (capt), Abdullah Fazal, Ali Usman, Arafat Minhas, Azan Awais, Mohammad Abbas, Ghazi Ghori, Mohammad Suleman, Mohammad Taha, Razaullah, Saad Baig, Salman Agha, Sameer Minhas, Saud Shakeel
news.content: علی عثمان نیز پس از اعزام به خانه از تور انگلیس به تیم آزمون فراخوانده شده است. سلمان آقا کاپیتان سابق تیم کریکت پاکستان برای سری‌لانکا به تیم تست پاکستان بازگشته است، اما پس از تور فاجعه‌بار این تیم در انگلیس، هنوز جایی برای محمد رضوان وجود نداشت. آقا و رضوان از سری هفت بازیکن تستور انگلیس که در آگوست بازدید کرده بودند، جایی نداشتند. 3-0. در اولین تیم پاکستان از آن زمان، 5 بازیکن از دست رفته باقی مانده اند، از جمله رضوان ضربه گیر ویکت بان، که موضوع تحقیقات مداوم توسط آژانس جرایم سایبری این کشور است. اوایل این هفته، کریکت بورد پاکستان (PCB) به رضوان اجازه داد در یک مسابقه داخلی شرکت کند. آقا از سری T20 این ماه مقابل سریلانکا کنار گذاشته شد، اما این بازیکن 32 ساله در سری مسابقات بین المللی یک روزه (ODI) در خانه تحت تاثیر قرار گرفت و یکشنبه گذشته یک قرن به سریلانکا گل زد. همراه با آقا، علی عثمان، بازوی چپ نیز پس از اعزام به خانه از سومین تور آزمایشی انگلیس به خانه فراخوانده شد. بابر اعظم در دو تست مقابل سریلانکا در راولپندی (9 تا 13 نوامبر) و لاهور (17 تا 21 نوامبر) رهبری تیم را ادامه خواهد داد. تیم 14 نفره شامل سه بازیکن بدون بازی است - محمد طاها، سامیر مینهاس و محمد سلیمان - که در مسابقات قهرمانی داخلی پاکستان به خوبی موفق شده اند. و آخرین و سریلانکا هفتم. جوخه: بابر اعظم (سروان)، عبدال

news.originalContent:
Speaking at the World Investment Forum in Doha, state minister says peace and security are essential for trade and investment prosperity.

Doha, Qatar – Qatar’s Minister of State for Foreign Trade Affairs Ahmad bin Mohammed al-Sayed has called for greater international cooperation and economic stability, warning that trade and investment cannot flourish without peace and security.

Speaking at the United Nations-led World Investment Forum in Doha on Sunday, al-Sayed said geopolitical upheaval and growing economic fragmentation were threatening global investment prospects.

“The global economy is undergoing changes. There are geopolitical changes. These are all issues that redefine the landscape of global investment,” he said.

“We believe that investment in the future is related to investment in peace and security,” the minister added.

“Trade will prosper, and long-term investment will create its potential only with a safe and stable environment.”

Organised by the UN Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD), the World Investment Forum brings together heads of state, policymakers, CEOs and investors to discuss global investment, opportunities, challenges and sustainable development.

Al-Sayed’s remarks come as several conflicts continue to rage around the world, and with growing fears of an escalation in the US-Israel war on Iran in the coming weeks.

Shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, a vital waterway for global oil and liquefied natural gas (LNG) shipments, has been disrupted since the US and Israel launched the war on February 28. Iran responded by effectively blocking the strait and attacking targets across the region.

Prior to the war, one-fifth of the world’s traded oil and gas flowed through the strait.

In the past week, escalating attacks on shipping in the strait and uncertainty over diplomatic efforts to end the nearly eight-month war have led to a surge in oil prices, putting further pressure on the global economy.

On Thursday, oil prices climbed about 4 percent to a five-month high, with Brent futures crossing $113.17 a barrel.

Al-Sayed stressed the need for predictable international rules and stronger economic partnerships at a time of heightened uncertainty.

“In our world, which is facing further uncertainty and economic fragmentation, our message stays clear. It is a call for further cooperation and less isolation, further cooperation and less division,” he said.

Iranian strikes on Qatar’s Ras Laffan industrial complex in March damaged facilities, with repairs expected to take several years.

The minister outlined Qatar’s efforts to strengthen supply chains, diversify economic partnerships and “open new markets for our exports”.

He said Qatar attracted 373 foreign direct investment projects in 2025, a 50 percent increase from the previous year, generating more than 15,000 jobs.

Qatar has also unveiled infrastructure projects worth $38.5bn over the next five years, alongside an anticipated $22.5bn in private sector investment in hospitality and real estate, al-Sayed added.
news.content: وزیر امور خارجه در سخنانی در مجمع جهانی سرمایه گذاری در دوحه می گوید که صلح و امنیت برای رونق تجارت و سرمایه گذاری ضروری است. دوحه، قطر - احمد بن محمد السید وزیر امور تجارت خارجی قطر خواستار همکاری بیشتر بین المللی و ثبات اقتصادی شد و هشدار داد که تجارت و سرمایه گذاری بدون صلح و امنیت نمی تواند شکوفا شود. السید روز یکشنبه در سخنرانی در مجمع جهانی سرمایه گذاری به رهبری سازمان ملل در دوحه گفت که تحولات ژئوپلیتیکی و چندپارگی اقتصادی فزاینده چشم انداز سرمایه گذاری جهانی را تهدید می کند. وزیر امور خارجه افزود: ما معتقدیم سرمایه گذاری در آینده با سرمایه گذاری در صلح و امنیت مرتبط است. مجمع جهانی سرمایه‌گذاری که توسط کنفرانس تجارت و توسعه سازمان ملل متحد (UNCTAD) برگزار می‌شود، سران کشورها، سیاست‌گذاران، مدیران عامل و سرمایه‌گذاران را گرد هم می‌آورد تا در مورد سرمایه‌گذاری جهانی، فرصت‌ها، چالش‌ها و توسعه پایدار بحث کنند. اظهارات السید در حالی بیان می‌شود که درگیری‌های متعدد در سراسر جهان ادامه دارد و با افزایش نگرانی‌ها از تشدید جنگ در ایران در هفته‌های آینده بیان می‌شود. حمل و نقل از طریق تنگه هرمز، یک آبراه حیاتی برای حمل و نقل جهانی نفت و گاز طبیعی مایع (LNG) است.

news.originalContent:
Evictions, raids and outpost expansion continue across the occupied West Bank amid heightened tensions.

Israeli forces have turned Palestinian homes in the city of Hebron into barracks and observation posts after forcing residents to leave, as a military operation in the southern occupied West Bank continues, the Palestinian news agency Wafa has reported.

They took over homes in the Khallat Manna and Dahiyat al-Zaytoun areas of southern Hebron to use them as barracks, and forced residents from homes in other neighbourhoods to use the properties as observation posts, Wafa said, citing sources.

The Israeli military has imposed a lockdown in Hebron and conducted hundreds of raids since two armed Palestinian men allegedly carried out an attack on an Israeli army reserve base on Friday, killing two soldiers. The two suspects were also killed.

The evictions follow the forced displacement of hundreds of families amid extensive raids, road closures and tight restrictions on movement.

According to the Palestinian Prisoner’s Society, Israeli forces have detained at least 47 Palestinians across Hebron since Friday, while forcibly displacing 293 families, comprising about 2,200 people.

Among those displaced from Hebron are 127 infants, 81 pregnant women and 26 people with disabilities, the NGO told Al Jazeera. The displaced also include 134 Palestinians with chronic illnesses and 265 elderly people over the age of 60.

Israeli troops also conducted hundreds of field interrogations, subjecting Palestinians to detention and abuse, the group said.

Meanwhile, Israeli settlers began establishing two new outposts on Palestinian-owned land in the town of Yatta, south of Hebron, Wafa reported.

Activist Osama Makhamra told Wafa that settlers began setting up an outpost in the Khallet al-Fara area, west of Yatta, where they pitched a tent, brought in bulldozers and excavation machinery, and started levelling and digging the land in preparation for construction.

He added that another outpost was established in the Yatta desert area, on Palestinian-owned land between the villages of az-Zuweidin and Umm Qussa, where settlers pitched several tents and began installing infrastructure, including water and electricity networks.

Near Bethlehem, Israeli forces continued to close roads and entrances across the governorate for the third consecutive day on Sunday, affecting several towns and villages, Wafa reported.

On Saturday, Israeli forces shut down dirt roads leading to Tuqu to block access, firing tear gas canisters and stun grenades towards Palestinian vehicles travelling along rough alternative routes near the town.

The latest attacks and closures come days before Israel’s general elections and as tensions remain high across the occupied Palestinian territory, where settlers, backed by the military, have carried out a wave of pogroms targeting olive harvesters.
news.content: اخراج ها، یورش ها و گسترش پاسگاه ها در سراسر کرانه باختری اشغالی در بحبوحه تشدید تنش ها ادامه دارد. خبرگزاری فلسطینی وفا گزارش داده است که نیروهای اسرائیلی خانه های فلسطینیان در شهر الخلیل را پس از وادار کردن ساکنان به ترک، به پادگان ها و پست های دیده بانی تبدیل کرده اند، زیرا عملیات نظامی در جنوب کرانه باختری اشغالی ادامه دارد. وفا به نقل از منابع گفت که آنها خانه ها را در مناطق خلعت منا و ضاحیه الزیتون در جنوب الخلیل تصرف کردند تا از آنها به عنوان پادگان استفاده کنند و ساکنان خانه های محله های دیگر را مجبور کردند از این املاک به عنوان پست های دیده بانی استفاده کنند. ارتش اسرائیل از زمانی که دو مرد مسلح فلسطینی در روز جمعه به پایگاه ذخیره ارتش اسرائیل حمله کردند و دو سرباز را کشتند، یک قرنطینه در الخلیل اعمال کرد و صدها حمله انجام داد. این دو مظنون نیز کشته شدند. این اخراج ها به دنبال آواره شدن اجباری صدها خانواده در میان یورش های گسترده، بسته شدن جاده ها و محدودیت های شدید در رفت و آمد است. به گفته انجمن اسیران فلسطینی، نیروهای اسرائیلی از روز جمعه حداقل 47 فلسطینی را در سراسر الخلیل بازداشت کرده اند، در حالی که 293 خانواده را که شامل حدود 2200 نفر می شود، به زور آواره کرده اند. آوارگان همچنین شامل 134 فلسطینی مبتلا به بیماری های مزمن و 265 فرد مسن بالای 60 سال هستند. نیروهای اسرائیلی همچنین صدها بازجویی میدانی انجام دادند.

در آستانه انتخابات میان‌دوره‌ای آمریکا، جنگ با ایران همچنان آینده‌ای نامعلوم دارد. مذاکرات تهران و واشنگتن برای پایان  دادن به درگیری‌ها به نتیجه نرسیده و تنش‌ها در منطقه همچنان ادامه دارد.

دونالد ترامپ، رئیس‌جمهور آمریکا،‌ گفته است که پیش از انتخابات سوم نوامبر به ایران حمله نخواهد کرد، اما افزایش قیمت نفت و پیامدهای اقتصادی جنگ، دولت او را در هفته‌های پایانی کارزار انتخاباتی جمهوری‌خواهان تحت فشار گذاشته است.

در این میان، گزارش‌ها درباره احتمال اقدامات تازه ایران برای افزایش فشار بر آمریکا و تحرکات احتمالی اسرائیل، بر ابهامات درباره آینده جنگ در آستانه انتخابات سوم نوامبر افزوده است. در واشنگتن نیز احتمال توافقی ناگهانی برای پایان جنگ یا تشدید دوباره درگیری‌ها، به بخشی از بحث‌ها درباره انتخابات تبدیل شده است.

در فرهنگ سیاسی آمریکا، تحولی که در هفته‌های پایانی رقابت‌های انتخاباتی رخ دهد و بتواند معادلات را تغییر دهد، نامی آشنا دارد: «غافلگیری اکتبر» (October Surprise).

این اصطلاح طی دهه‌های گذشته به رویدادهای گوناگونی اطلاق شده است؛ از اعلام قریب‌الوقوع بودن پایان یک جنگ تا افشای رسوایی‌های نامزدها، انتشار اطلاعات محرمانه یا تصمیمی غیرمنتظره از سوی یک نهاد حکومتی.

اما تاریخچه این عبارت، ارتباطی مستقیم با ایران دارد. هرچند «غافلگیری اکتبر» پیش از سال ۱۹۸۰ نیز به کار رفته بود، رواج آن در معنای سیاسی امروزی به بحران گروگان‌گیری سفارت آمریکا در تهران بازمی‌گردد؛ زمانی که رونالد ریگان و اطرافیانش نگران بودند جیمی کارتر با آزادی ناگهانی گروگان‌ها در آستانه انتخابات ریاست‌جمهوری، شکست احتمالی خود را به پیروزی تبدیل کند.

آن غافلگیری هرگز اتفاق نیفتاد، اما اصطلاحی که از دل نگرانی جمهوری‌خواهان شهرت یافت، در سیاست آمریکا ماندگار شد.

از آن زمان، رویدادهای متعددی عنوان «غافلگیری اکتبر» گرفته‌اند، بی‌آنکه روشن باشد تا چه اندازه بر نتیجه انتخابات اثر گذاشته‌اند. در اینجا چند نمونه را مرور می‌کنیم.

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

در آستانه انتخابات ریاست‌جمهوری سال ۱۹۸۰، جیمی کارتر،‌ رئیس‌جمهور دموکرات آمریکا، در حالی برای انتخاب مجدد تلاش می‌کرد که ۵۲ آمریکایی همچنان در تهران گروگان بودند.

نزدیک به یک سال از اشغال سفارت آمریکا گذشته بود. مذاکرات برای آزادی گروگان‌ها بی‌نتیجه مانده بود و عملیات نظامی آمریکا برای نجات آنها در صحرای طبس نیز در آوریل همان سال شکست خورده بود.

بحران گروگان‌گیری به نماد اصلی مشکلات سیاست خارجی جیمی کارتر تبدیل شد و رونالد ریگان، رقیب جمهوری‌خواه او، از آن برای حمله به دولت استفاده کرد.

با این حال، در ستاد انتخاباتی ریگان نگرانی دیگری وجود داشت: اینکه کارتر بتواند در واپسین روزهای رقابت‌ها، گروگان‌ها را آزاد کند و با اعلام این موفقیت، ورق انتخابات را به سود خود برگرداند.

ویلیام کیسی، مدیر کارزار انتخاباتی ریگان، از تابستان همان سال درباره احتمال چنین اتفاقی هشدار می‌داد. او می‌ترسید رئیس‌جمهور دموکرات درست پیش از رای‌گیری به توافقی با تهران برسد.

اصطلاح «غافلگیری اکتبر» در همین فضا شهرت یافت. به نوشته نیویورک‌تایمز، این عبارت در اردوگاه رونالد ریگان برای توصیف نگرانی از آزادی گروگان‌ها پیش از انتخابات رواج یافت.

اما اکتبر به پایان رسید و گروگان‌ها آزاد نشدند.

رونالد ریگان در چهارم نوامبر جیمی کارتر را با اختلافی چشمگیر شکست داد. کمتر از سه ماه بعد، در ۲۰ ژانویه ۱۹۸۱، درست در روز تحلیف ریگان، گروگان‌های آمریکایی پس از ۴۴۴ روز اسارت آزاد شدند.

این هم‌زمانی به یکی از جنجالی‌ترین اتهام‌های تاریخ انتخابات آمریکا دامن زد: آیا اطرافیان رونالد ریگان مخفیانه با مقام‌های جمهوری اسلامی تماس گرفته بودند تا آزادی گروگان‌ها را به بعد از انتخابات موکول کنند؟

گری سیک، از اعضای شورای امنیت ملی دولت کارتر، از جمله کسانی بود که بعدها این اتهام را مطرح کرد. بر اساس این روایت، نمایندگانی از کارزار ریگان با واسطه‌های ایرانی درباره به تاخیر انداختن آزادی گروگان‌ها در ازای دریافت امتیازاتی احتمالی مذاکره کرده بودند. ادعاهایی نیز درباره دیدارهای محرمانه در مادرید و پاریس مطرح شد.

این اتهامات به تحقیقات رسمی کنگره آمریکا انجامید. هیئتی از مجلس نمایندگان در سال ۱۹۹۳ اعلام کرد شواهد معتبری برای اثبات تبانی ستاد ریگان با ایران نیافته است.

اما پرونده بسته نشد. در مارس ۲۰۲۳، بن بارنز، سیاستمدار سابق آمریکایی، در گفت‌وگو با نیویورک‌تایمز مدعی شد که جان کانلی، فرماندار پیشین تگزاس و از حامیان ریگان، در تابستان ۱۹۸۰ طی سفری به چند کشور خاورمیانه از رهبران منطقه خواسته بود به تهران پیام دهند که آزادی گروگان‌ها را تا پس از انتخابات به تاخیر بیندازد.

شواهد تاریخی اصل سفر را تایید می‌کند، اما روشن نیست که چنین پیامی به مقام‌های ایرانی رسیده یا بر تصمیم‌گیری آنها تاثیری گذاشته باشد.

منبع تصویر، AFP via Getty Images

در ۳۰ اکتبر ۱۹۹۲، تنها چهار روز مانده به انتخابات ریاست‌جمهوری آمریکا، انتشار اطلاعات تازه‌ای درباره رسوایی ایران-کنترا، جورج بوش پدر را در موقعیت دشواری قرار داد.

ماجرای ایران-کنترا به فروش محرمانه تسلیحات آمریکا به جمهوری اسلامی در دهه ۱۹۸۰ بازمی‌گشت. دولت رونالد ریگان امیدوار بود از این طریق به آزادی گروگان‌های آمریکایی در لبنان کمک کند. بخشی از درآمد این معاملات نیز برخلاف محدودیت‌های قانونی، به شورشیان مخالف دولت نیکاراگوئه، معروف به کنتراها، منتقل شده بود.

پیش از انتخابات ۱۹۹۲، لارنس والش، بازپرس مستقل پرونده، کیفرخواست تازه‌ای علیه کاسپار واینبرگر، وزیر دفاع پیشین آمریکا، صادر کرد که در آن بخشی از یادداشت‌های او درباره جلسه‌ای در کاخ سفید در سال ۱۹۸۶ نقل شده بود.

این یادداشت‌ها نشان می‌داد جورج بوش، برخلاف اظهارات قبلی‌اش، در جریان جزئیات طرح مبادله تسلیحات با گروگان‌های آمریکایی در لبنان بوده و با وجود مخالفت وزیران خارجه و دفاع، از آن حمایت کرده است.

در یادداشت واینبرگر همچنین آمده بود که او و جورج شولتز، وزیر خارجه وقت، با طرح مخالفت کرده بودند؛ مخالفتی که بوش پیش‌تر گفته بود از شدت آن اطلاع نداشته است.

انتشار این اطلاعات در واپسین روزهای انتخابات، بار دیگر عملکرد جورج بوش پدر در ماجرای ایران-کنترا را زیر سوال برد. جمهوری‌خواهان، لارنس والش را به تلاش برای تاثیرگذاری بر انتخابات متهم کردند، اما دفتر او این اتهام را رد کرد.

چهار روز بعد، جورج بوش انتخابات را به بیل کلینتون باخت. با این حال، روشن نیست انتشار این اسناد تا چه حد بر نتیجه رای‌گیری تاثیر داشته است.

منبع تصویر، DEWIRA/AFP via Getty Images

در ۲۹ اکتبر ۲۰۰۴، تنها چهار روز مانده به انتخابات ریاست‌جمهوری آمریکا، اسامه بن‌لادن با انتشار پیامی ویدیویی بار دیگر به صدر اخبار بازگشت.

شبکه الجزیره ویدیویی از رهبر القاعده پخش کرد که در آن مستقیما مردم آمریکا را خطاب قرار می‌داد و درباره حملات ۱۱ سپتامبر و سیاست خارجی واشنگتن سخن می‌گفت.

سه سال از آن حملات گذشته بود. جورج بوش جنگ افغانستان و سپس حمله به عراق را آغاز کرده بود، اما بن‌لادن هنوز به عنوان رهبر القاعده فعالیت می‌کرد.

انتشار این پیام، درست در روزهای پایانی رقابت بوش و جان کری، نامزد دموکرات‌ها، بار دیگر مسئله تروریسم و امنیت ملی را به مرکز توجه رسانه‌ها کشاند، اما مشخص نبود این اتفاق به سود کدام نامزد تمام خواهد شد.

از یک سو، برخی تحلیلگران معتقد بودند یادآوری تهدید القاعده می‌توانست به نفع بوش باشد که مبارزه با تروریسم را یکی از محورهای اصلی ریاست‌جمهوری خود قرار داده بود. از سوی دیگر، حضور دوباره بن‌لادن یادآور ناکامی دولت آمریکا در دستگیری او بود.

در نهایت جورج بوش در انتخابات دوم نوامبر پیروز شد، اما میزان تاثیر پیام بن‌لادن بر نتیجه انتخابات هرگز روشن نشد.

این اتفاق نمونه متفاوتی از غافلگیری اکتبر بود. این بار نه یک سیاستمدار آمریکایی، بلکه دشمنی که آمریکا سال‌ها در تعقیب او بود، با انتشار پیامی در حساس‌ترین روزهای انتخابات به موضوع اصلی بحث‌های سیاسی تبدیل شد.

انتخابات ریاست‌جمهوری سال ۲۰۱۶ مجموعه‌ای از اتفاقات غیرمنتظره را در خود داشت که هرکدام می‌توانست به تنهایی عنوان «غافلگیری اکتبر» بگیرد.

در هفتم اکتبر، واشنگتن‌پست ویدیویی از دونالد ترامپ منتشر کرد که در سال ۲۰۰۵ ضبط شده بود. او در گفت‌وگو با بیلی بوش، مجری برنامه سرگرمی «اکسس هالیوود»، با کلماتی رکیک درباره زنان و رفتار جنسی خود صحبت می‌کرد.

انتشار این ویدیو موجی از انتقادها را برانگیخت. شماری از سیاستمداران جمهوری‌خواه حمایت خود را از دونالد ترامپ پس گرفتند و برخی حتی خواهان کناره‌گیری او از رقابت شدند. ترامپ از سخنان خود عذرخواهی کرد و گفت این صحبت‌ها بازتاب‌دهنده شخصیت واقعی او نبوده است.

در همان روز، ویکی‌لیکس انتشار هزاران ایمیل هک‌شده جان پودستا، رئیس ستاد انتخاباتی هیلاری کلینتون، را آغاز کرد.

نهادهای اطلاعاتی آمریکا بعدها این عملیات هک را به عوامل روسی نسبت دادند. تحقیقات بعدی نیز شواهد گسترده‌ای درباره نقش روسیه در سرقت و انتشار اطلاعات مربوط به حزب دموکرات و ستاد کلینتون ارائه کرد.

به این ترتیب، در یک روز دو افشاگری متفاوت فضای انتخابات را تحت تاثیر قرار داد. اما ماجرای اکتبر ۲۰۱۶ به همین‌جا ختم نشد.

در ۲۸ اکتبر، تنها یازده روز مانده به رای‌گیری، جیمز کومی، رئیس وقت اف‌بی‌آی، در نامه‌ای به کنگره اعلام کرد که ماموران اف‌بی‌آی ایمیل‌های تازه‌ای یافته‌اند که ممکن است با تحقیقات درباره استفاده کلینتون از سرور خصوصی ایمیل در دوران وزارت خارجه او ارتباط داشته باشند.

اف‌بی‌آی چند ماه پیش‌تر تحقیقات خود را به پایان رسانده و اعلام کرده بود با وجود انتقاد از نحوه نگهداری اطلاعات حساس، توصیه‌ای برای پیگرد کیفری کلینتون ندارد.

اما نامه تازه این تصور را ایجاد کرد که شاید اطلاعات جدیدی کشف شده و نتیجه بررسی‌های قبلی تغییر کرده باشد.

ایمیل‌ها در جریان تحقیق جداگانه‌ای درباره آنتونی وینر، همسر وقت هما عابدین، از نزدیک‌ترین دستیاران کلینتون، پیدا شده بودند. هنگام ارسال نامه، اف‌بی‌آی هنوز بررسی آنها را تکمیل نکرده بود.

خبر به سرعت به صدر رسانه‌ها راه یافت و دونالد ترامپ آن را دستمایه حمله به رقیب خود قرار داد.

در ششم نوامبر، تنها دو روز مانده به انتخابات، کومی اعلام کرد بررسی ایمیل‌های تازه نتیجه تحقیقات قبلی را تغییر نداده است. اما تا آن زمان، این ماجرا بیش از یک هفته از مهم‌ترین سرخط‌های خبری انتخابات بود.

دونالد ترامپ در انتخابات هشتم نوامبر پیروز شد و هیلاری کلینتون بعدها تصمیم جیمز کومی را یکی از عوامل شکست خود دانست.
